title: MotionSampleV1
description: Anchor motion protocol v1 sample. All vectors use the frame assumed by the current mounting convention: phone lying flat, screen up, portrait orientation, top edge pointing toward vehicle front. In that assumed frame, X positive = right, Y positive = forward, Z positive = up. sessionElapsedUs is a monotonic session-relative clock in microseconds, not a Unix timestamp or wall-clock time. sessionId is an opaque identifier and is not authentication. This frame is not yet calibrated; controlled datasets are used to validate the axis interpretation before future zero/calibration work.

Vector3.description: Three-axis vector in the frame assumed by the current mounting convention: X positive = right, Y positive = forward, Z positive = up.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version. Incompatible changes must use protocolVersion 2 or later.

sessionId.description: Opaque session identifier. This field is not authentication or authorization material.

sessionElapsedUs.description: Monotonic microseconds elapsed since the session start. This is not a Unix timestamp or wall-clock time.

allOf.description: Linear acceleration without gravity in meters per second squared.

x.description: Linear acceleration along the assumed right axis in m/s^2.

y.description: Linear acceleration along the assumed forward axis in m/s^2. Forward acceleration is hypothesized to have y > 0 and braking y < 0 under the current mounting convention.

z.description: Linear acceleration along the assumed up axis in m/s^2.

allOf.description: Gravity vector in meters per second squared. Under the current mounting convention and while stationary, gravity is expected to be approximately z = -9.80665.

x.description: Gravity along the assumed right axis in m/s^2.

y.description: Gravity along the assumed forward axis in m/s^2.

z.description: Gravity along the assumed up axis in m/s^2. Under the current mounting convention and while stationary, this is expected to be approximately -9.80665.

allOf.description: Angular velocity in radians per second.

x.description: Angular velocity around the assumed right axis in rad/s.

y.description: Angular velocity around the assumed forward axis in rad/s.

z.description: Angular velocity around the assumed up axis in rad/s.
